revision_summary: One quote-anchoring fix and one significant missed-pattern fix required. (1) In script_coverage's tax_credit_qualifier row, the customer_quote 'Oh, I I I don't know. I didn't really know. Sorry.' is timestamped 03:30 but actually occurs at 03:59; 03:30 is where the rep states the qualifier itself. Correct the ts to 03:59 (or split into two rows: rep ask at 03:30, customer resistance at 03:59). (2) Stage 3 misses the schema-flagged credit-threshold drift: the rep states 'credit score above six fifty' (650) at 03:34/03:41, which directly matches the schema's documented drift_observed pattern (670 vs 650, previously seen in SESSION18_fcbf33c1). This should be surfaced explicitly as a schema_drift_detection finding, not just implied via the operator_note reference buried in the 03:59 coaching_implication. (3) Correct the schema_reference in cherry_pick_moments[0] (00:18, 'Is there a charge for this?') — protocols.how_did_you_get_my_number doesn't match this trigger; use rebuttals.price_estimate_before_design or note it as an unmapped legitimacy-screen moment. (4) Soften/reconsider the 'cost' classification of the Social Security disclosure in objections[1] — it reads more cleanly as a vulnerability disclosure than a scored objection with rep_attempts, since the rep never engaged with it as something to rebut. All other quotes, the outcome dispute, and the overall trajectory read are well-supported and should be preserved as-is.
